title: Change OrderService.getOrder from a positional identifier to a request object
visiblePrompt: Change the `OrderService.getOrder` contract from a positional identifier `getOrder(orderId)` to a named request object `getOrder({ orderId })` across the public contract, the implementation, the HTTP route, the CLI adapter, the test double, and the visible tests. Route and CLI behavior must remain unchanged. After the change, `getOrder` must reject a positional string argument with a `TypeError`. Avoid unrelated edits and run appropriate verification.
